messages: I want a refund for order 1234
name: 59 — the-M user with another role is turned away
description:
Same kind of door (the-M account login), but marked: 'developers only'.
The same test user is an admin, not a developer, so he is stopped (HTTP 403).
What we check: a real login with the wrong role cannot get in.
Setup: python3.12 test-runner/scripts/setup_ep_role_scenario.py (creates the doors; --reset undoes). Login used: payops-test, whose the-M membership role is 'admin'.
